title: Apple App Store Metadata & Ratings Scraper
description: Look up factual public app metadata and aggregate ratings using numeric Apple App Store IDs or official app URLs.

appIds.title: App IDs or URLs
appIds.description: Up to 50 numeric App Store IDs, such as 6448311069, or official https://apps.apple.com/.../idAPP_ID URLs.

maxResults.title: Maximum apps
maxResults.description: Maximum number of unique app IDs to process. Start with 1 for a quick test.

country.title: Storefront country
country.description: Two-letter Apple storefront country code, such as us, gb, or in.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy settings for official API lookups. The default quick test does not use a proxy.
